key_points_missing: Primary constructors don't automatically become read-only properties
key_points_wrong: States parameters are 'automatically available as read-only properties' -- they are captured as parameters, not auto-properties
brief_justification: Primary constructor parameters are NOT automatically read-only properties; they're parameters available in the class body. The example uses record (not class) which muddles the distinction. FrozenDictionary and collection expressions are correct.
